ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (dark gray to black) across the visible surface, with localized high-intensity pixels (white) appearing in clusters at the tips and linear markings on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A solid dark-tone contiguous field occupies the majority of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge, characterized by medium-frequency pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve fitting the trailing edge from the central notch to the elevated outer tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel regions located on the outer distal edges and tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the central portion of the left lobe, varying in length and width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe surface and heavy calcareous-like colonization (barnacles) on the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Metadata text overlay at the bottom of the frame including 'ID 10053' and a handwritten label 'Roman'.
